## Checklist

- [ ] Originals are never changed (or the tool previews, asks first, and can undo)
- [ ] Friendly progress messages and clear next steps
- [ ] Plain-English comments for non-developers
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] Guide in `docs/tools/` updated (and README / `start.py` menu, for a new tool)
